term: brute concrete root under world-local existential grounding
definition: The shared actual concrete root predicate is DEF-ACTUAL-ROOT, with exact Lean locator NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot. Here 'brute' means only that this root lacks an actual concrete predecessor under the stipulated world-local existential-grounding relation. It need not be temporally first, uncaused under another relation or fully unexplained. WellFounded (grounds w) is an additional condition over the whole candidate carrier. Neither all grounds being concrete nor all explanations being causes is assumed. ContingentAt must be added when a contingent root is intended.
note: An analyst's model for #505/#487, with deliberately narrow sense of 'brute'. Alternative abstract, intrinsic and global explanations remain open; do not identify absence of modeled concrete predecessors with absolute explanatory absurdism. Application-scope clarification: an abstract Profile theorem leaves grounds parametric; applying it to reality must specify whether an R edge represents a productive existential contributor, an enabling condition, or both. A direct productive contribution need not be individually or jointly sufficient. Profile supplies no endpoint-presence, production, completeness or asymmetry law; ActualConcreteGround guards the source, while ActualRoot and the actual-node graph additionally guard their target. The JointGroups.recorded adapter places all incoming graph neighbours in contributors and leaves enablers empty solely as representation, with no sufficiency claim. It does not choose a productive interpretation. A fixed joint condition is not a new individual and supplies no new Being witness for contingent grounding C. Changing the interpretation affects acceptance of C, cause-to-R F, priority-to-R G and asymmetry O; it does not change the already verified conditional proof. Neither Profile.grounds, Ontic.Causes, the separate PowerExistenceBoundary.supportsEsse nor Aquinas conservation is silently identified with another relation. Roothood excludes selected actual-concrete predecessors only, not every possible explanation or absolute dependence. #1103: Profile.concrete is a parameter; intended interpretations instantiate it with the adopted esse sense (DEF-CONCRETE-ESSE-IN-RE), and many logical fixtures set it constantly True with a declared reason (category-constant markers). Lean locator: NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot m w x is the predicate described here: ActualConcrete m w x ∧ ∀ y, ¬ ActualConcreteGround m w y x. Both actual-concrete guards use this same Profile, selected world and candidate carrier. Profile is the input container, not a definition of roothood; the pointer asserts no well-foundedness, absolute explanatory completeness or applicability of the grounding interpretation.
